hero.title: Offline advertising,
hero.description: In Africa, physical advertising represents the majority of marketing budgets. No one measures any of it. Phygi Ads changes that.

problem.title: Brands spend millions without knowing what works.
problem.description: Posters, flyers, bread bags, POS displays… Physical advertising takes up the bulk of marketing budgets in Africa. Zero data. Zero audience. Zero attribution.

cards.title: No measurement
cards.description: Brands don't know how many people saw their message, or whether it generated any action.

cards.title: No audience
cards.description: Impossible to know who was exposed to the campaign — age, neighborhood, purchase frequency… all unknown.

cards.title: No attribution
cards.description: Impossible to link a sale to a physical ad. Decisions are made blind.

cards.title: Wasted budget
cards.description: Without data, budgets are allocated based on gut feelings. A large portion is ineffective.

solution.title: Phygi Ads turns every bread bag into a measurable medium.
solution.description: We combine the power of physical media — its reach, proximity, and recurrence — with digital measurability. For the first time, offline advertising becomes as traceable as Facebook Ads.

network.title: A network of bakeries at the heart of every neighborhood.
network.description: Our partners are present in every district of Abidjan, in every working-class and residential neighborhood. Every bag distributed is a qualified touchpoint.

cta.title: Ready to measure your campaigns?
cta.description: Join the pioneer brands transforming their physical advertising into actionable data.

hero.title: Phygi Ads
hero.titleEm: The measurement infrastructure for physical advertising.
hero.description: The first African platform connecting physical advertising to digital data. What Nielsen did for TV, Phygi Ads does for the field.

how.title: From bread bag to real-time dashboard.
how.description: Phygi Ads connects every physical advertising support to a digital tracking infrastructure. Every impression becomes data. Every scan becomes an insight.

steps.title: Physical distribution
steps.description: Bread bags printed with unique QR codes are distributed through the network of partner bakeries.

steps.title: Consumer activation
steps.description: The consumer scans the QR code to access an offer, a promo, or brand content.

steps.title: Data collection
steps.description: Each scan returns geolocation, time, frequency, and anonymized demographic profile.

steps.title: Advertiser dashboard
steps.description: The advertiser accesses their real-time dashboard: reach, engagement, audience profile, estimated ROI.

data.title: What Phygi Ads measures for you.
data.description: For the first time, physical advertising generates data comparable to the best digital campaigns.

cards.title: Geolocation
cards.description: District, neighborhood, heat map. Know exactly where your message resonates most.

cards.title: Timing
cards.description: Scan time, day of week, activity peaks. Optimize your next campaigns for the right time slots.

cards.title: Audience profile
cards.description: Anonymized demographic data, browsing behavior, declared interests via the landing page.

cards.title: Frequency
cards.description: Rescan rate, recurrence, zone loyalty. Measure repetition of exposure to your message.

cards.title: Conversion
cards.description: Clicks, page views, forms filled, promo codes used. The full funnel of physical advertising.

cards.title: Estimated ROI
cards.description: Proprietary attribution model linking scans to sales declared by the advertiser.

features.title: Local trust
